lane.meaning: zero-height center lane along forward axis

facetFan.purpose: three broad 2m-grid planes: retained lane, slightly raised camera-left shoulder, slightly lowered camera-right shoulder; preview multipliers are white at the boundary and multiply the existing baked map

notRuntime: No height sampler, terrain query, mesh, physics, support, resource, home, scenery, save, or color source is changed by this file.

limits: Preview math only; runtime has no candidate height/color term. A render harness must supply a fresh white-identity multiplier color attribute and a cloned material with vertexColors=true; it must not reuse current sampled terrain RGB as the multiplier.
The central lane mask is a design constraint, not a completed player-footprint/support proof.
Future authoritative integration must use one shared final rootbound height/color term so terrain mesh, query, physics surfaces and supports agree.
